```artifact
/* Finite State Machine (FSM) for Proximal Tube and Obstruction Alarms */
states:
  ProximalTubeConnected,
  ProximalTubeDisconnected,
  NoObstruction,
  Obstruction;

events:
  ProximalTubeConnectedEvent,
  ProximalTubeDisconnectedEvent,
  VTIReading;

transitions:
  ProximalTubeConnected -> ProximalTubeDisconnected on ProximalTubeDisconnectedEvent
    when isConnected = false;
  ProximalTubeDisconnected -> ProximalTubeConnected on ProximalTubeConnectedEvent
    when isConnected = true;
  NoObstruction -> Obstruction on VTIReading when vti < 100
    priority = high;
  Obstruction -> NoObstruction on VTIReading when vti >= 100
    priority = medium;

initial_state: ProximalTubeConnected;

alarm_states:
  MediumPriorityAlarm,
  HighPriorityAlarm;

alarm_transitions:
  MediumPriorityAlarm -> Inactive on ProximalTubeConnected
    priority = medium;
  HighPriorityAlarm -> Inactive on VTI >= 100
    priority = high;
```
